campaign.name: The Copper Ferry
campaign.promise: Choices change the harbor and its people.
core_truths: The sabotage was practical, not supernatural.
faction_intents: The guild wants the ferry closed before the audit.
outcomes: Expose the guild or bargain for immediate repairs.

hero.name: Mara Vey
hero.visual_description: Adult human woman with wind-burned olive skin, dark braided hair, alert brown eyes, and a compact athletic build.
visual_must_preserve: brass ferry token at the collar
hero.visual_clothing: Weathered green courier coat over practical leather armor
hero.visual_gear: Dockside lute, rope, sealed payroll satchel
hero.visual_colors: Moss green, dark leather, aged brass

opening.title: The Cut Cable
opening.pressure: A worker hangs above the river while a thief reaches for the payroll.
opening.npc_intent: The ferryman wants both the worker and payroll saved.
opening.sensory_detail: Fresh tar cuts through the rain.
opening.question: What does Mara do?

visual.label: Copper Ferry rescue
visual.prompt: Grounded fantasy realism, a rain-soaked ferry rescue, one clear moment, no text.
